verdict.rationale: As a DGX system sold with full-stack software, B300 could plausibly ship job scheduling, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents only hardware specs, the OS base, BMC/Redfish/IPMI management, and Kubernetes deployment guidance for NIM. None of these is a first-party capability for scheduling recurring jobs or workflows. The Kubernetes mention is a host-platform feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
